title: orca.yaml
description: Orca IDE project configuration. Derived from the orca.yaml parser in Orca 2026.x; Orca ignores unknown keys and invalid values silently.

scripts.description: Lifecycle scripts run in the worktree shell.

setup.description: Runs when a new worktree is created.

archive.description: Runs when a worktree is archived.

setupAgentStartupPolicy.description: Whether the agent starts before the setup script finishes.

issueCommand.description: Command run to fetch linked issue context.

defaultTabs.description: Terminal tabs opened in a new worktree. An entry needs at least one of title, color, command.

environmentRecipes.description: Per-workspace environment recipes (disposable sandboxes or VMs).

id.description: Unique recipe id: 1-64 lowercase letters, numbers, dot, dash, underscore; must start with a letter or number.

command.description: Deprecated alias for create; used only when create is absent.

destroy.description: Teardown command. The literal value "none" disables teardown.

cleanup.description: Deprecated alias for destroy; used only when destroy is absent.

sharedDirectories.description: Repo-relative directories shared across worktrees. Absolute paths, .., . and .git are rejected.
